request: v2 of the Embassy Threat Monitor. Same upstream feed (GDELT 1.0 every 3 hours), same 60-post US diplomatic roster, same 50mi/90d windows and 5-band risk scoring. Adds the GDELT free-text-ish columns the v1 flow already pulled but didn't surface: Actor1Name, Actor2Name, ActionGeo_FullName, EventCode (leaf taxonomy + human label), and a composed one-sentence event_summary (Actor1Name + verb + Actor2Name @ ActionGeo_FullName on YYYY-MM-DD) so each row reads as a sentence. The per-post roll-up also gains top_event_summary + top_event_source_url so an analyst sees *why* a post is rated where it is without drilling. GDELT 1.0 has no narrative description field; this is the most natural-language surface available short of switching to the GKG feed.

sources.name: GDELT Global Events (Threat Filter)
sources.description: GDELT 1.0 latest daily events feed from data.gdeltproject.org. Daily index file is scraped, the most recent .CSV.zip is downloaded, unzipped, parsed. The downstream embassy_threat_join script applies CAMEO root-code filtering (13/14/17/18/19/20) and 90-day date filtering; the API caller pulls the full feed unfiltered.

args.name: Embassy Threat Join
args.description: Spatial-joins GDELT events to a curated US diplomatic-post roster (50mi haversine). Same scoring as v1 (severity, proximity, recency, US-actor, composite). v2 additions: actor1_name, actor2_name, action_geo_fullname, event_code, event_full_name (human verb for the leaf CAMEO code), and event_summary — a composed one-sentence narrative per row.

args.name: Embassy Risk Summary
args.description: Per-post weighted threat-score roll-up over a 7-day window with the same 5-band classification as v1 (CRITICAL / HIGH / ELEVATED / GUARDED / LOW). v2 additions: top_event_summary (sentence describing the top-severity recent event at this post) and top_event_source_url (the news link backing that event).

outputs.name: Embassy Threat Events v2
outputs.description: v2: one row per (US diplomatic post, GDELT event) within 50mi of the post over the most recent feed window. Adds the GDELT as-reported descriptive fields the v1 flow already fetched but didn't surface: actor1_name, actor2_name, action_geo_fullname, event_code (4-digit leaf CAMEO code, e.g. 1822 = tortured), event_full_name (human verb for that leaf), and event_summary (composed one-sentence narrative — 'Police Force threatened with force Protesters in Cairo, Egypt on 2026-06-22.'). All other columns identical to v1. Refresh: every 3 hours via local prep-cli + .hyper upload.

outputs.name: Embassy Risk Summary v2
outputs.description: v2: one row per US diplomatic post in the curated roster. All v1 fields (risk_band, weighted_threat_score, per-class counts, top_event_type) plus top_event_summary (the as-reported sentence describing the highest-severity recent event at this post) and top_event_source_url (the GDELT source URL for that event). Use these new columns so the operations dashboard shows *why* a post is in its current band without drilling into the events extract.
